journey.title: Useful bounded design with degraded sources
journey.purpose: Useful bounded design with degraded sources with explicit authority, provenance and evidence boundaries.

steps.intent: Identify the unavailable source and what remains usable.
Inspect cached context with source age and limitations.
Narrow a large selection instead of rendering an unbounded graph.
Continue permitted draft work without implying observation or apply readiness.

claims.statement: Given stale or unavailable observation, when browsing continues, then the interface distinguishes incomplete evidence from a healthy empty ecosystem.
claims.rationale: Documentation-first target; runtime bindings and evidence remain to be implemented and qualified.
